title: 溪山?画
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.48 m, eave 3.68 m, ridge 6.47 m above the ground

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons. No text or drawing names it in 日下旧闻考 j80-82, the Qianlong poems on Kanripo, 養吉齋叢錄, Malone 1934, the witnesses of 1860, what search indexes show of the Yangshi Lei drawings.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 溪山?画 (? marks an unread character), 2x1 cells.
